checks.title: Listings: no empty listing_id
checks.detail: All listing rows must carry a non-empty _id.

checks.title: Products: no empty product_id
checks.detail: product_id is required on every product.

checks.title: Products: no empty title
checks.detail: title is required on every product.

checks.title: Products: listing_ids not empty
checks.detail: Every product must map to >= 1 listing.

checks.title: Attributes: attr_key not null
checks.detail: Every EAV row must name an attribute key.

checks.title: Listings sharing a product_id
checks.detail: 1,920 documented: the same product is listed under multiple catalog entries.

checks.title: Products present in multiple listings
checks.detail: Documented (max 25 listings for one product).

checks.title: Products: product_id unique
checks.detail: Products layer must be 1 row per product.

checks.title: Attributes: duplicate (product, key, value) triples
checks.detail: Deduped at load time into the EAV table; artifact keeps raw rows.

checks.title: No zero/negative selling_price
checks.detail: Selling price must be positive.

checks.title: No zero/negative MRP
checks.detail: MRP must be positive.

checks.title: selling_price never exceeds MRP
checks.detail: Business sanity: price <= MRP.

checks.title: price_band matches selling_price
checks.detail: Recomputed from PRICE_BANDS thresholds.

checks.title: discount_pct within 0..100
checks.detail: Discount must be a percentage in [0, 100].

checks.title: effective_discount_pct within 0..100
checks.detail: Discount must be a percentage in [0, 100].

checks.title: avg_rating within 0..5
checks.detail: Ratings must be on the 0-5 scale.

checks.title: has_rating consistent with avg_rating
checks.detail: Flag and value must agree.

checks.title: rating_bucket matches avg_rating
checks.detail: Recomputed from RATING_BUCKETS thresholds.

checks.title: category and sub_category not blank
checks.detail: Taxonomy fields are required.

checks.title: No 'Unknown' taxonomy
checks.detail: Category cleaning never emits Unknown.

checks.title: Products without a raw brand
checks.detail: 2,009 documented; mapped to Unknown brand (id 0).

checks.title: Raw brand present => canonical resolved
checks.detail: Every raw brand must resolve to a canonical value.

checks.title: Blank canonical only when raw brand missing
checks.detail: Blank brand_canonical is allowed for the 2,009 no-brand products; DB maps them to Unknown brand id 0.

checks.title: Brands still suspected of truncation
checks.detail: Values >= 10 chars; kept because the seller vocabulary cannot corroborate a longer expansion.

checks.title: product_id not blank
checks.detail: Primary key of the products layer.

checks.title: listing_id values are well-formed UUIDs
checks.detail: All listing ids match the UUID format.

checks.title: listing_ids resolve to listings
checks.detail: Every product listing id must exist in the listings layer.

checks.title: Column dtypes match the data contract
checks.detail: All 40+ columns conform to expected types.

checks.title: listing_ids contains lists of strings
checks.detail: Nested column must be an array of strings.
